inventory.missingReason: Original mobile group hit assertion fails before capture; failure bounds, hit points and screenshot were not persisted by that original helper.

findings.assessment: All six actually viewed Chinese originals render readable Chinese text where R1 samples showed missing glyphs. Actual CJK font package/family provenance is retained. This finding closure does not turn the failed queue into a pass.

findings.case: C: zh-cn/brutalist/enhanced keeps full mobile navigation targets
findings.sourceLocation: sprint2-site.browser.test.ts fullNativeHitTarget line150 called for group at line321
findings.assessment: At least one of four original inner-edge points failed exact closest anchor/summary owner equality for the nearest Brutalist summary. Actual failing coordinates/rect/hit target were not recorded; neither layout nor timing cause is established. Original enhanced screenshot is absent because capture occurs after the failed assertion. Separate passing controls cannot replace it.
